text:
jen: Heads-up from the postmortem 1: nightly batch overlap caused autoscaler oscillation and temporary GPU exhaustion. We should assign owners for three remediation tracks: quota/fractional reserve, scheduler eviction tweaks, and proactive runway alerts.

omar: I'll take fractional reserve (soft reserve) and the acceptance tests. Idea: keep a floor of 10% fractional reserve for interactive pools, plus a short buffer for cold-start padding. ETA: 7 days.

trent: I'll own scheduler eviction tuning. Plan is to change the eviction weight so background jobs release memory earlier and to add a short 'damp' window to avoid immediate re-packing. Will run microbenchmarks.

jen: nice. infra-sre, can you help me scope what metrics we can expose to support a "predicted runway" alert (1h and 6h windows)? Prefer a simple AR(3) baseline + flagging from model later.

infra-sre: we can expose per-pool reserved_pct, active_jobs_count, and 1m/5m/15m avg usage. We'll add a synthetic metric: predicted_runway_seconds (linear & ar3) — can be toggled per-cluster. PR in a day.

omar: for fractional reserve acceptance tests, I'll simulate the nightly convergence: ramp batch QPS up x4 for 20m and verify interactive pools maintain tail latency < 200ms and reserve never drops below floor. Test snippet: 

```
# acceptance
ramp(batch_qps=4x, duration=1200s)
assert(tail_latency(interactive) < 200ms)
assert(reserved_pct(interactive) >= 10%)
```

trent: scheduler note: currently small background containers are being packed into almost-full GPUs because we use cpu_frac first. Proposing new score: `score = mem_frac*1.4 + cpu_frac*0.6 + age_secs*0.001` so older batch jobs are deprioritized. I'll run with this in staging.

jen: good. make sure to capture p50/p95/p99 for both interactive and batch workloads and token-cost delta.

alert-bot: Created remediation tickets: M-5601 (fractional-reserve), M-5602 (scheduler-eviction-damp), M-5603 (runway-metrics).

omar: also proposing a short-circuit: if predicted_runway_seconds < 1800s AND sustained growth rate > 5%/m then trigger preemptive scale and page. This prevents last-minute scramble.

infra-sre: we can implement the short-circuit in alert rules. Will add a cooldown of 15m to avoid noisy pages.

trent: blocker: need per-job mem_frac histogram logs from the last 30 days to tune thresholds. @infra-sre can you backfill?

infra-sre: yes, will backfill histograms for 30 days; may take a few hours. I'll post when ready.

jen: ownership recap: omar -> M-5601 (fractional reserve + tests, due in 7d), trent -> M-5602 (scheduler eviction + microbenchmarks, due in 5d), infra-sre -> M-5603 (runway metrics + alert rules, PR by EOD tom). We'll add these to the postmortem follow-ups list.

omar: I'll add a simple dashboard card showing reserved_pct and predicted_runway_side-by-side for ops.

trent: I'll try a small chaos run after tuning (preempt a GPU and measure pack/unpack). test harness snippet: 

```
# chaos
kill_gpu(node=spot-03)
measure(pack_latency, tail_latency)
```

alert-bot: Linking postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/1745123456.

jen: perfect. let's sync in 72 hours to review results and ship defaults. If anyone hits blockers ping here. Thanks everyone :rocket:
